description: 这是一个群峦重生和车万女仆的兼容性mod

mods.name: tfcmaid
mods.description: "This mod serves as an intermediary layer between TerraFirmaCraft 2 and Touhou Little Maid.It removes incompatible maid tasks from TerraFirmaCraft, fixes numerous incompatibility issues, and adds compatibility adjustments for TerraFirmaCraft.Additionally, it introduces a wide range of new TerraFirmaCraft-themed maid tasks, covering various aspects of gameplay.If you encounter any bugs or crashes while playing with this mod, please report issues to "TFCMaid Mod" rather than to Touhou Little Maid.The mod is currently in development, and releases are in snapshot versions."

releases.notes:
添加了女仆收集干草的任务
优化了织布任务的状态机，并将织布任务的寻路优化到对方块实体寻路的大类（之前设计有问题，织布机的方块实体变动大，导致经常识别不到，结果是我设计有误，现在优化之后给他移到封装的类上去了，有利于后续代码维护）
